messages.author: 6824c1e1fe15ab15
messages.subject: Endotherm and DEB
parts:
Hey Mike! Just wanted to ask whether the endotherm model in R is ready to be linked to the DEB processes in the same way as the ectotherm model. I wasn't sure if it's at the point where I can do Dynamic Energy Budgets of mammals yet.

Thank you!
Adam

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Endotherm and DEB
parts:
Hi Adam,

Not quite but that is a priority for this year. Marko Jusup and I are refining exactly how to compute heat production from the DEB model and will then finalise a whole-life-cycle bird model. For mammals we also need to integrate a variant of the standard DEB model that includes lactation, which was largely worked out in collaboration with Bas Kooijman during Jess Roberts' PhD work. Also the software note for the endoR model is still in review but that will hopefully appear by the middle of the year.

All the best,
Mike
